design_description: A refined navy design inspired by Zaragoza, with the Basílica del Pilar illustrated tonally around the lower hem. The architectural artwork continues across front and back, creating a panoramic connection to the city and the Río Ebro. Deep blue-on-navy detailing keeps the landmark subtle, allowing the white crest, sponsor and player graphics to remain dominant. White double-line detailing on the collar and cuffs gives the kit a clean, classic finish. Overall, an elegant local-identity design that integrates Zaragoza's architecture and riverside landscape without overwhelming the shirt.
